blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Boutique carrier Sunlight Air is pausing plans to launch international flights and acquire larger aircraft as it focuses on weathering the Middle East crisis, which has weighed heavily even on larger airlines. Currently, the airline, which launched a year before the pandemic, flies to five domestic destinations through its hubs in Clark and Cebu. It also operates a fleet of four turboprop aircraft.
